import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
PLAN_SHA = 'f8d194d1157e0bed6a554033d4203727c2d99efd79a79119d450440be810ef41'
assert hashlib.sha256((DATA / 'v92-plan.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == PLAN_SHA
assert not list(DATA.glob('v92-build-attempt*.json')) and not list(DATA.glob('v92-build-self-check-attempt*.json'))
assert not list(DATA.glob('v92-runner-self-check-attempt*.json')) and not (DATA / 'v92-run-identity.json').exists()
value = dict(passed=True, created_at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    plan_sha256=PLAN_SHA, before_first_check_and_real_build=True, public_lp_runs=0,
    interpretation=[
        '计划的measure摘要是LD归一残差的有限double舍入值，不要求逐位精确可表示。只对此类非负残差量，正LD窄化下溢为0仍可记录0，不能由摘要0反推精确残差0；LD非finite或窄化溢出为null。算法始终用原LD量判<=1，未改变任何门槛。',
        'accepted必须final_measure和5个block_measures摘要有限且<=1，5个tolerances是有限正double。initial_measure或失败快照可以因无完成检查或摘要窄溢为null，不能据其猜原真实方向。',
        '独立核Work内部可使用not_started与arithmetic_error，但第二marker last非空时只输出冻结的7种状态。adapter须将内部arithmetic_error归numerical_error，并在原BudgetExpired捕获桥标budget；其他外部异常标exception。未实际开始方向时last为null，不输出not_started末记录。',
        '以上只澄清schema显示与C++异常桥；同一主env、原5块算子、固定容差、初始P+32列3周期、96耗尽失败、公共计数语义、预算/精度/集合/门槛/罚分全部不变。'],
    driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
    driver_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
with (DATA / 'v92-pretest-clarification.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    json.dump(value, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True, public_lp_runs=0,
    clarification_sha256=hashlib.sha256((DATA / 'v92-pretest-clarification.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()), ensure_ascii=False))
